risk_factors.heading: Existing indebtedness and inability to access capital markets
risk_factors.quote: The debt instruments governing our indebtedness contain covenants that may restrict our business activities or our ability to execute our strategic objectives, and our failure to comply with these covenants could result in a default under our indebtedness.

risk_factors.heading: Existing indebtedness and inability to access capital markets
risk_factors.quote: Additionally, any downgrade in the ratings that rating agencies assign to us and our debt may ultimately impact our access to capital markets.

risk_factors.heading: Product liability lawsuit, warranty claim or product recall
risk_factors.quote: In the event that our products fail to, or are alleged to fail to, perform as expected, regardless of fault, and such failure or alleged failure results in, or is alleged to result in, bodily injury and/or property damage or other losses, we may be subject to product liability lawsuits and other claims.

risk_factors.heading: Product liability lawsuit, warranty claim or product recall
risk_factors.quote: Our customers may also pursue claims against us for contribution of all or a portion of the amounts sought in connection with product liability, warranty and recall claims related to our products.

risk_factors.heading: Various legal and regulatory proceedings and claims
risk_factors.quote: We are involved in various legal and regulatory proceedings and claims that, from time to time, are significant.

risk_factors.heading: Human rights and environmental laws and customer requirements
risk_factors.quote: Concerns over human rights, environmental pollution and climate change have produced significant legislative and regulatory efforts globally. In addition, our customers have imposed various requirements on their suppliers, including us, in response to these concerns.

risk_factors.heading: New or changed laws or regulations
risk_factors.quote: The introduction of new laws or regulations or changes in existing laws or regulations, or the interpretation thereof, could increase the costs of doing business for us or our customers or suppliers or restrict our actions

risk_factors.heading: Violations of anti-bribery, trade and other laws
risk_factors.quote: the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the U.K. Bribery Act and similar anti-bribery laws in other jurisdictions generally prohibit companies and their intermediaries from making improper payments to government officials for the purpose of obtaining or retaining business

risk_factors.heading: Environmental laws and regulations compliance costs
risk_factors.quote: Material future expenditures may be necessary if compliance standards change or material unknown conditions that require remediation are discovered.

risk_factors.heading: Intellectual property rights developments or assertions
risk_factors.quote: Failure to successfully protect our intellectual property could adversely impact our business. Furthermore, we may not be able to readily identify unauthorized use or take appropriate and timely steps to enforce our intellectual property rights.

risk_factors.heading: Intellectual property rights developments or assertions
risk_factors.quote: while we believe we have the necessary rights to use all of the intellectual property we use, if we are found to infringe on the rights of others, we could be adversely impacted.
